book.name: Luqaasa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Luqaasi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Qasseka Yesusi Issi Harganchcha Sambata Gallas Paththides
Issi gallas Yesusi quma maanaas Farsaaweta halaqatappe issaa soo gelida wode asay wuri Yesusi ay ooththanaakko giidi ayfe iza bolla tokki xeellides.
Heenkka izas asateththay puuriin waayettiza issi asi iza sinththan dees.
Yesusikka Muse wogaa erizaytanne Farsaaweta, «Sakettizaade Sambata gallas paththanaas koshshizeyee? Koshshennee?» giidi oychchides.
Isttika co7u gida; izikka addeza bochchidi paththi yeddides.
Qasseka, «Inttefe issi asas Sambata gallas nay woykko booray kundidi ollan gelikko eeson heerakka kessonttaadey oonee?» gides.
Isttika oyshaas aykko zaarokka demmanaas dandaybeettenna.
Bana Ziqqi Histteththinne Imaththa Moko
Xeygettida asati uttanaas bonchchoso koyishin Yesusi be7idi leemisora isttas,
«Issi asi nena sarges xeygikko bonchchoson uttofa; neeppe bollara bonchchettizaadey xeygettiko,
inttena nam7atakka xeygidaadey yiidi, ‹Ne uttidasohoza hayssaades yedda› gaana; nenikka yeellatashe ziqqaso baandasa.
Gido attiin ne xeygettida wode ziqqaso xeellada utta; nena xeygidaadey yiidi, ‹Ta laggezoo! Haa ya dhoqqasohon utta› gaandes; nenikka he wode nenara maaddan uttida asaa ubbaa sinththan bonchchettana.
Gaasoykka bana dhoqqu histtizaadey wuri ziqqi gaana; bana ziqqi histtizaadey wuri dhoqqu gaana» gides.
Yesusikka xeygida addeza, «Quma woykko kawo mizanaas xeyssiko neyssaththo nena xeyssidi mizontta mala ne laggeta woykko ne ishata, ne dabbota woykko dureta woykko dure gutata xeygoppa.
Gido attiin asaa xeyssada mizana koykko manqota, kushey, tohoy baynda wobbetanne qooqeta xeyssa; neni anjjettana.
Xeygettidayti kushe zaaranaas dandayontta gishshas xillota denththa wode nees kushey zaarettana» gides.
Wogga Gibira Leemiso
Maaddan Yesusara issife uttidaytappe issoy hayssa siyidi, «Xoossa Kawoteththan shiiqidi maaddaafe miza asi anjjettidaade» gides.
Yesusikka, «Issi asi wolqqama gibira giigsidi daro as xeygides.
«Gibira maana wodeykka gakkiin xeygettida imaththata, ‹Wurikka giigida gishshas haa yiite!› giidi xeygana mala ba ashkara yeddides.
Gido attiin wurikka baas hara gaaso shiishshidi issoy, ‹Ha7i gade shammadis; ta baada beyanaas bessees; hachchis tana lanccofa› gides.
«Hankkoyssika, ‹Tani ichchashu waaxa boora shammadis; istta paacca xeellana gishshas hach tana lanccofa› gides.
«Qasse hara issaadeyka, ‹Tani buro mishirateththan days; baanaas dandaykke› gides.

«Oosanchchazi kiitettidasoppe simmidi heedzdzati gidayssa ba godaas yootides; he wodekka gibira giigsidayssi hanqettidi oosanchchaza, ‹Elle oyddu oge kezada manqota, kusheynne tohoy baynda wobbeta, qomaaxatanne ayfey baynda qooqeta haa gelththa› gides.
«Oosanchchazikka zaaridi, ‹Ta Godoo! Ne tana azazidayssa ubbaa poladis; ha7ikka hara uteththasoy dees› gides.
«Godazikka oosanchchaza, ‹Gede oyddu oge kezada ta keeththe kumana mala pudenne duge aadhdhizayta wolqqara haa gelththa.
Tani tuma gays; gibiraa maana xeygettidaytappe issaadeyka doonan gelththenna› » gides.
Yesusa Kaaloy Bana Yarsho Koyees
Daro derey izara issife bizayssa Yesusi be7idi guye simmi,
«Taakko yizay wuri ba aawaa, ba machchonne nayta, ba ishatanne michcheta, ba shemppo gidiin ixxontta aggiko tana kaallizaade gidanaas dandayenna.
Ba masqale tookkidi tana kaallonttay tana kaallizaade gidanaas dandayenna.
«Inttefe issi asi keeththe keexxanaas koykko polanaas dandayanaakkonne dandayonttaakko koyrottidi baas diza bira qopponttay oonee?
Keeththaa keexxana doommidi wursanaas hanontta ixxiko be7ida asi wuri iza bolla miiccana.
Isttika, ‹Hayssi addezi keeththe keexo oykkides shin polibeenna› gi miiccana.
«Woykko issi kawoy hara kawora olas giigettidi nam7u tammu shii as ekki yiza kawo zaaranaas tammu shii ola asara zaaranaakko uttidi qopponttay oonee?
Ola zaaranaas dandayetontta misatidi beettiko buro haahon dishin maqaynnanaas gaanna yeddees.
Hessaththoka inttefe oonakka gidiin baas dizayssa aggonttay tana kaallizaade gidanaas dandayenna.
Mal7ontta Maxine Leemiso
«Maxiney lo7oshin ba maxineteththaa mal7o yeddiko zaaridi waani mal7ana dandayzee?
Gaden yeggiin aradisontta gishshas coo kare wora yegettees; siyiza hayththi diza asi siyo!» gides.
